subject: Game Theory
title: Backward Induction
description: Learn Backward Induction in one minute.

hook.text: Chess masters think from the endgame backward. The best business strategists do the same.

buildup.text: Backward induction starts at the final decision and works backward: 'If they do X last, I should do Y now.'

discovery.text: This technique solves sequential games—any situation where players take turns making decisions.

twist.text: In practice, backward induction assumes perfect rationality. Real players make mistakes, changing the calculus.

climax.text: Firms use it in negotiations: 'If we walk away, they'll accept our offer to avoid losing the deal.'

punchline.text: Think from the end to find the start.
